newsitem.title: USA: D.R. Horton files $250 million shelf.
newsitem.headline: D.R. Horton files $250 million shelf.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $250 million in debt securities, preferred and common stock.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including development of non-residential properties, acquisition of residential development properties and/or other homebuilding companies and repayment of existing debt, the company said in the filing.

D.R. Horton, based in Arlington, Texas, is a national homebuilder constructing and selling single-family homes in metropolitian areas of the Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, Southeast and Western regions of the United States.
